title: Premarket movers: Nvidia, Intel fall; J&J gains
summary: Investing.com - U.S. stock index futures were mixed on Monday, with Nasdaq 100 futures leading declines as investors looked ahead to Nvidia’s quarterly results for fresh clues about the strength of artificial intelligence demand. The cautious mood followed a week in which Wall Street posted gains despite a sharp selloff in the chipmaker’s shares, with uncertainty surrounding its leadership adding to concerns about the outlook for the AI trade.
